svg.title: RL feedback loop — three training iterations, scores 6 / 7 / 8 out of 10
svg.desc: Animated circular feedback loop with three training iterations. Each iteration shows the Generator emit a building variant routed through the Evaluators which return a score that updates the adapters. The Architectural Quality evaluator lists four procedural criteria: Accessibility, Daylight, Efficiency and Furnishability. Only one arrow is visible at a time — as each new arrow draws in, the previous one fades out, so the eye follows a single travelling pulse around the loop. Building and score swap by fade-out/in; the Adapters and Evaluators dashed-bg briefly darken to signal updates.
